trailhead.label: Cima Gogna, on the SS52 before Auronzo, the board’s start

cautions: The start is beside the busy SS52 at Cima Gogna: keep your dog on a short lead there.
The last stretch to Zamberlan is very steep: take it slowly with an older or less fit dog.
Forest track open to forestry vehicles: keep your dog close if one comes.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The start is beside the busy SS52 at Cim: La partenza è accanto alla trafficata SS52 a Cima Gogna: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.The last stretch to Zamberlan is very st: L’ultimo tratto fino a Zamberlan è molto ripido: vai piano con un cane anziano o meno allenato.
textIt.Forest track open to forestry vehicles:: Strada forestale aperta ai mezzi forestali: tieni il cane vicino se ne arriva uno.
